lines: three brass multiplication symbols fused into one interlocking sculptural form, bone white matte body with one warm amber accent surface on the central junction, plain solid black background, one soft key light from above with gentle falloff, soft contact shadow, seen from directly above, filling two thirds of the frame and reaching past two edges
